import OrderRouter.Spec
import OrderRouter.Lemmas
namespace OrderRouter

/-- Regular and RLP paths: send the available liquidity capped at the shares not yet sent. -/
def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun _ s e =>
  match e with
  | .parent q f =>
    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])
  | .route id liq => routeBySent s id liq
  | .ack _ => (s, [])
  | .fill k q =>
    if k < s.nChildren then
      let c := s.children k
      let x := min q (c.qty - c.done)
      let p := s.parents c.parent
      let p' := ({ p with cum := p.cum + x } : ParentRec)
      ({ s with parents := upd s.parents c.parent p',
                children := upd s.children k { c with done := c.done + x } }, [])
    else (s, [])

theorem req_normal_order_routed : NormalOrderRouted step := sorry
theorem req_routes_available    : RoutesAvailable step := sorry
theorem req_never_overroute     : NeverOverroute step := sorry
theorem req_stop_when_filled    : StopWhenFilled step := sorry
theorem req_no_excess_execution : NoExcessExecution step := sorry
theorem req_fill_accounting     : FillAccounting step := sorry

end OrderRouter

import OrderRouter.Spec
import OrderRouter.Lemmas
namespace OrderRouter

/-- Regular and RLP paths: send the available liquidity capped at the shares not yet sent. -/
def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun _ s e =>
  match e with
  | .parent q f =>
    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])
  | .route id liq => routeBySent s id liq
  | .ack _ => (s, [])
  | .fill k q =>
    if k < s.nChildren then
      let c := s.children k
      let x := min q (c.qty - c.done)
      let p := s.parents c.parent
      let p' := ({ p with cum := p.cum + x } : ParentRec)
      ({ s with parents := upd s.parents c.parent p',
                children := upd s.children k { c with done := c.done + x } }, [])
    else (s, [])

def arch0_Inv (x : Sys) : Prop :=
  x.st.nParents = x.tr.nOrders ∧
  x.st.nChildren = x.tr.kids.length ∧
  (∀ id, id < x.tr.nOrders →
    (x.st.parents id).qty = x.tr.qty id ∧
    (x.st.parents id).sent = x.tr.sent id ∧
    (x.st.parents id).cum = x.tr.exec id) ∧
  (∀ k, k < x.tr.kids.length →
    ∃ kid, x.tr.kids[k]? = some kid ∧
      x.st.children k = ⟨kid.parent, kid.qty, kid.done⟩ ∧
      kid.parent < x.tr.nOrders) ∧
  (∀ id, x.tr.sent id ≤ x.tr.qty id)

theorem arch0_inv_start : arch0_Inv start := by
  sorry

  sorry

    arch0_Inv (run step b evs) := by

    x.st.nParents = x.tr.nOrders := by
  sorry

theorem arch0_parent_qty_of_inv {x : Sys} (h : arch0_Inv x)
    {id : Nat} (hid : id < x.tr.nOrders) :
    (x.st.parents id).qty = x.tr.qty id := by

      c = ⟨pid, min liq ((s.parents pid).qty - (s.parents pid).sent)⟩ ∧

  intro b evs id liq
  exact arch0_route_output_of_inv b (run step b evs) id liq
    (arch0_inv_run b evs)

theorem req_never_overroute : NeverOverroute step := by
  intro b evs id
  exact arch0_sent_le_qty_of_inv (arch0_inv_run b evs) id

  intro b evs e id hfilled c hc heq
  have hInv : arch0_Inv (run step b evs) := arch0_inv_run b evs

    exact hlt
  have hid : id < (run step b evs).tr.nOrders := by
    rw [← hpid]
    exact hidPid
  have hqty := arch0_parent_qty_of_inv hInv hid
  have hsent := arch0_parent_sent_of_inv hInv hid
  have hsent_le := arch0_sent_le_qty_of_inv hInv id

        ((run step b evs).st.parents pid).sent = 0 := by
    rw [hpid, hqty, hsent]

    (arch0_sent_le_qty_of_inv (arch0_inv_run b evs) id)

  intro b evs id hid
  exact arch0_parent_cum_of_inv (arch0_inv_run b evs) hid

import OrderRouter.Spec
import OrderRouter.Lemmas
namespace OrderRouter

/-- Regular and RLP paths: send the available liquidity capped at the shares not yet sent. -/
def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun _ s e =>
  match e with
  | .parent q f =>
    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])
  | .route id liq => routeBySent s id liq
  | .ack _ => (s, [])
  | .fill k q =>
    if k < s.nChildren then
      let c := s.children k
      let x := min q (c.qty - c.done)
      let p := s.parents c.parent
      let p' := ({ p with cum := p.cum + x } : ParentRec)
      ({ s with parents := upd s.parents c.parent p',
                children := upd s.children k { c with done := c.done + x } }, [])
    else (s, [])

theorem test_unfold (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : (step Build.rlp s (.route id liq)).2 = (routeBySent s id liq).2 := by rfl

  induction l with
  | nil => rfl

/-!
# Child-order router specification (protected)

A model of an automated order router of the kind described in the SEC order against Knight
Capital Americas LLC (Release No. 34-70694, October 16, 2013), reconstructed from the SEC
findings. Knight's code is not public; nothing here is Knight's code.

The router receives parent orders and, as liquidity becomes available, sends child orders
to trading venues for execution (paragraph 12 of the order). Each parent order carries a
flag; in the order, the flag that formerly activated "Power Peg" was repurposed for the
Retail Liquidity Program (paragraph 13). Each server runs one code version, and on
August 1, 2012 one of the eight servers still had the Power Peg code (paragraphs 15 and 16).

Every requirement is a predicate over an implementation `step : Impl` and quantifies over
every code version, every flag value, every parent order and every sequence of events
(new parent orders, routing opportunities, acknowledgements and execution reports,
including reports for unknown child orders and reports larger than the order). The
locked challenge (`OrderRouter/Challenge.lean`) applies each one to the definition hole
`OrderRouter.step`.

The quantities the requirements talk about (shares ordered, shares sent in child orders,
shares executed) are computed by this file from the event sequence and the child orders the
router emitted, never from the router's own state, so a router cannot satisfy them by
under-reporting.
-/

namespace OrderRouter

/-- The code version a server runs. `rlp` is the new code; `legacy` is a server to which the
new code was not copied, where the Power Peg code is still present and callable. -/
inductive Build where
  | rlp
  | legacy
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- A child order as sent to a venue: the parent order it represents and its share
quantity. Child orders are numbered 0, 1, 2, ... in the order they are sent. -/
structure Child where
  parent : Nat
  qty    : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Inputs to the router. Parent orders are numbered 0, 1, 2, ... in arrival order.
`route id liq` is a routing opportunity for parent `id`: venues show `liq` shares
available. `ack k` acknowledges child order `k`. `fill k q` is an execution report:
`q` shares of child order `k` were executed. -/
inductive Event where
  | parent (qty : Nat) (flag : Bool)
  | route (id : Nat) (liq : Nat)
  | ack (child : Nat)
  | fill (child : Nat) (q : Nat)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Function update. -/
def upd {α : Type} (f : Nat → α) (k : Nat) (v : α) : Nat → α :=
  fun j => if j = k then v else f j

/-! ## Router state (the implementation reads and writes it) -/

/-- The router's record of a parent order: its quantity and flag, the shares it has sent in
child orders, and its cumulative executed quantity (the "cumulative quantity function" of
paragraph 14 of the order). -/
structure ParentRec where
  qty  : Nat
  flag : Bool
  sent : Nat
  cum  : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- The router's record of a child order: its parent, quantity and executed shares. -/
structure ChildRec where
  parent : Nat
  qty    : Nat
  done   : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Router state: parent records `0` to `nParents - 1` and child records `0` to
`nChildren - 1`. -/
structure State where
  nParents  : Nat
  parents   : Nat → ParentRec
  nChildren : Nat
  children  : Nat → ChildRec

/-- The router's state before any event. -/
def init : State :=
  { nParents := 0, parents := fun _ => ⟨0, false, 0, 0⟩,
    nChildren := 0, children := fun _ => ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ }

/-- A router: given the server's code version, its state and an event, the next state and
the child orders it sends in response. -/
abbrev Impl := Build → State → Event → State × List Child

/-! ## What actually happened (computed by this file, not by the router) -/

/-- A child order with the number of its shares executed at the venue. -/
structure Kid where
  parent : Nat
  qty    : Nat
  done   : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq,

import OrderRouter.Spec
import OrderRouter.Lemmas
namespace OrderRouter

/-- Regular and RLP paths: send the available liquidity capped at the shares not yet sent. -/
def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun _ s e =>
  match e with
  | .parent q f =>
    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])
  | .route id liq => routeBySent s id liq
  | .ack _ => (s, [])
  | .fill k q =>
    if k < s.nChildren then
      let c := s.children k
      let x := min q (c.qty - c.done)
      let p := s.parents c.parent
      let p' := ({ p with cum := p.cum + x } : ParentRec)
      ({ s with parents := upd s.parents c.parent p',
                children := upd s.children k { c with done := c.done + x } }, [])
    else (s, [])

theorem test_unfold (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : (step Build.rlp s (.route id liq)).2 = (routeBySent s id liq).2 := by rfl

theorem test_obs_parent (t : Truth) (q : Nat) (f : Bool) : (t.observe (.parent q f)).nOrders = t.nOrders + 1 := by simp [Truth.observe]

theorem tmp_route_out (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : (step Build.rlp s (.route id liq)).2 = (routeBySent s id liq).2 := rfl

theorem tmp_route_st (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : (step Build.rlp s (.route id liq)).1 = (routeBySent s id liq).1 := rfl

theorem sentFor_zero_of_ne (l : List Kid) (id : Nat) (h : ∀ k ∈ l, k.parent ≠ id) : sentFor l id = 0 := by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a as ih =>
    simp only [sentFor_cons]
    have ha : a.parent ≠ id := h a (by simp)
    simp [ha]
    exact ih (fun k hk => h k (by simp [hk]))

theorem inv_start : True := trivial
-- check unfold of advance for parent

theorem chk_adv_parent (st : State) (tr : Truth) (q : Nat) (f : Bool) (b : Build) :
    (advance step b ⟨st, tr⟩ (.parent q f)).1.nParents = st.nParents + 1 := by
  simp [advance, step]

theorem inv_npq_start : (start.st.nParents = start.tr.nOrders) := by rfl

theorem adv_parent_np (st : State) (tr : Truth) (q : Nat) (f : Bool) (b : Build) :
    (advance step b ⟨st, tr⟩ (.parent q f)).st.nParents = st.nParents + 1 := by
  simp [advance, step]

theorem adv_parent_nord (st : State) (tr : Truth) (q : Nat) (f : Bool) (b : Build) :
    (advance step b ⟨st, tr⟩ (.parent q f)).tr.nOrders = tr.nOrders + 1 := by
  simp [advance, Truth.observe, Truth.record]

theorem inv_nc_v1 (b : Build) (evs : List Event) :
    (run step b evs).st.nChildren = (run step b evs).tr.kids.length := by
  refine run_induction step b (fun x => x.st.nChildren = x.tr.kids.length) rfl ?_ evs
  intro x e hx
  cases e with
  | parent q f =>
    show ((advance step b x (.parent q f)).st.nChildren = (advance step b x (.parent q f)).tr.kids.length)
    simp [advance, step, Truth.observe, Truth.record, hx]
  | route id liq =>
    show ((advance step b x (.route id liq)).st.nChildren = (advance step b x (.route id liq)).tr.kids.length)
    simp only [advance]
    have hrec : ∀ (t : Truth) (out : List Child), (t.record out).kids.length = t.kids.length + out.length := by
      intro t out; simp [Truth.record]
    have hobs : (x.tr.observe (.route id liq)) = x.tr := rfl
    rw [hobs, hrec]
    simp only [step, routeBySent]
    split
    · simp [hx]
    · simp [hx]
  | ack k =>
    show ((advance step b x (.ack k)).st.nChildren = (advance step b x (.ack k)).tr.kids.length)
    simp [advance, step, Truth.observe, Truth.record, hx]
  | fill k q =>
    show ((advance step b x (.fill k q)).st.nChildren = (advance step b x (.fill k q)).tr.kids.length)
    simp only [advance]
    have hobs_len : ((x.tr.observe (.fill k q)).record (step b x.st (.fill k q)).2).kids.length = (x.tr.observe (.fill k q)).kids.length := by

import OrderRouter.Spec

namespace OrderRouter

/-- Regular and RLP paths: send the available liquidity capped at the shares not yet sent. -/
def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun _ s e =>
  match e with
  | .parent q f =>
    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])
  | .route id liq => routeBySent s id liq
  | .ack _ => (s, [])
  | .fill k q =>
    if k < s.nChildren then
      let c := s.children k
      let x := min q (c.qty - c.done)
      let p := s.parents c.parent
      let p' := ({ p with cum := p.cum + x } : ParentRec)
      ({ s with parents := upd s.parents c.parent p',
                children := upd s.children k { c with done := c.done + x } }, [])
    else (s, [])

import OrderRouter.Spec
import OrderRouter.Lemmas
namespace OrderRouter

/-- Regular and RLP paths: send the available liquidity capped at the shares not yet sent. -/
def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun _ s e =>
  match e with
  | .parent q f =>
    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])
  | .route id liq => routeBySent s id liq
  | .ack _ => (s, [])
  | .fill k q =>
    if k < s.nChildren then
      let c := s.children k
      let x := min q (c.qty - c.done)
      let p := s.parents c.parent
      let p' := ({ p with cum := p.cum + x } : ParentRec)
      ({ s with parents := upd s.parents c.parent p',
                children := upd s.children k { c with done := c.done + x } }, [])
    else (s, [])

import OrderRouter.Spec
import OrderRouter.Lemmas
namespace OrderRouter

/-- Regular and RLP paths: send the available liquidity capped at the shares not yet sent. -/
def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun _ s e =>
  match e with
  | .parent q f =>
    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])
  | .route id liq => routeBySent s id liq
  | .ack _ => (s, [])
  | .fill k q =>
    if k < s.nChildren then
      let c := s.children k
      let x := min q (c.qty - c.done)
      let p := s.parents c.parent
      let p' := ({ p with cum := p.cum + x } : ParentRec)
      ({ s with parents := upd s.parents c.parent p',
                children := upd s.children k { c with done := c.done + x } }, [])
    else (s, [])

import OrderRouter.Spec
import OrderRouter.Lemmas
namespace OrderRouter

/-- Regular and RLP paths: send the available liquidity capped at the shares not yet sent. -/
def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun _ s e =>
  match e with
  | .parent q f =>
    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])
  | .route id liq => routeBySent s id liq
  | .ack _ => (s, [])
  | .fill k q =>
    if k < s.nChildren then
      let c := s.children k
      let x := min q (c.qty - c.done)
      let p := s.parents c.parent
      let p' := ({ p with cum := p.cum + x } : ParentRec)
      ({ s with parents := upd s.parents c.parent p',
                children := upd s.children k { c with done := c.done + x } }, [])
    else (s, [])

theorem test_obs_parent (t : Truth) (q : Nat) (f : Bool) : (t.observe (.parent q f)).nOrders = t.nOrders + 1 := by simp [Truth.observe]

theorem tmp_route_st (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : (step Build.rlp s (.route id liq)).1 = (routeBySent s id liq).1 := rfl

/-!
# Child-order router specification (protected)

A model of an automated order router of the kind described in the SEC order against Knight
Capital Americas LLC (Release No. 34-70694, October 16, 2013), reconstructed from the SEC
findings. Knight's code is not public; nothing here is Knight's code.

The router receives parent orders and, as liquidity becomes available, sends child orders
to trading venues for execution (paragraph 12 of the order). Each parent order carries a
flag; in the order, the flag that formerly activated "Power Peg" was repurposed for the
Retail Liquidity Program (paragraph 13). Each server runs one code version, and on
August 1, 2012 one of the eight servers still had the Power Peg code (paragraphs 15 and 16).

Every requirement is a predicate over an implementation `step : Impl` and quantifies over
every code version, every flag value, every parent order and every sequence of events
(new parent orders, routing opportunities, acknowledgements and execution reports,
including reports for unknown child orders and reports larger than the order). The
locked challenge (`OrderRouter/Challenge.lean`) applies each one to the definition hole
`OrderRouter.step`.

The quantities the requirements talk about (shares ordered, shares sent in child orders,
shares executed) are computed by this file from the event sequence and the child orders the
router emitted, never from the router's own state, so a router cannot satisfy them by
under-reporting.
-/

namespace OrderRouter

/-- The code version a server runs. `rlp` is the new code; `legacy` is a server to which the
new code was not copied, where the Power Peg code is still present and callable. -/
inductive Build where
  | rlp
  | legacy
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- A child order as sent to a venue: the parent order it represents and its share
quantity. Child orders are numbered 0, 1, 2, ... in the order they are sent. -/
structure Child where
  parent : Nat
  qty    : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Inputs to the router. Parent orders are numbered 0, 1, 2, ... in arrival order.
`route id liq` is a routing opportunity for parent `id`: venues show `liq` shares
available. `ack k` acknowledges child order `k`. `fill k q` is an execution report:
`q` shares of child order `k` were executed. -/
inductive Event where
  | parent (qty : Nat) (flag : Bool)
  | route (id : Nat) (liq : Nat)
  | ack (child : Nat)
  | fill (child : Nat) (q : Nat)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Function update. -/
def upd {α : Type} (f : Nat → α) (k : Nat) (v : α) : Nat → α :=
  fun j => if j = k then v else f j

/-! ## Router state (the implementation reads and writes it) -/

/-- The router's record of a parent order: its quantity and flag, the shares it has sent in
child orders, and its cumulative executed quantity (the "cumulative quantity function" of
paragraph 14 of the order). -/
structure ParentRec where
  qty  : Nat
  flag : Bool
  sent : Nat
  cum  : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- The router's record of a child order: its parent, quantity and executed shares. -/
structure ChildRec where
  parent : Nat
  qty    : Nat
  done   : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Router state: parent records `0` to `nParents - 1` and child records `0` to
`nChildren - 1`. -/
structure State where
  nParents  : Nat
  parents   : Nat → ParentRec
  nChildren : Nat
  children  : Nat → ChildRec

/-- The router's state before any event. -/
def init : State :=
  { nParents := 0, parents := fun _ => ⟨0, false, 0, 0⟩,
    nChildren := 0, children := fun _ => ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ }

/-- A router: given the server's code version, its state and an event, the next state and
the child orders it sends in response. -/
abbrev Impl := Build → State → Event → State × List Child

/-! ## What actually happened (computed by this file, not by the router) -/

/-- A child order with the number of its shares executed at the venue. -/
structure Kid where
  parent : Nat
  qty    : Nat
  done   : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq,

import OrderRouter.Spec
import OrderRouter.Lemmas
namespace OrderRouter

/-- Regular and RLP paths: send the available liquidity capped at the shares not yet sent. -/
def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun _ s e =>
  match e with
  | .parent q f =>
    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])
  | .route id liq => routeBySent s id liq
  | .ack _ => (s, [])
  | .fill k q =>
    if k < s.nChildren then
      let c := s.children k
      let x := min q (c.qty - c.done)
      let p := s.parents c.parent
      let p' := ({ p with cum := p.cum + x } : ParentRec)
      ({ s with parents := upd s.parents c.parent p',
                children := upd s.children k { c with done := c.done + x } }, [])
    else (s, [])

theorem test_unfold (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : (step Build.rlp s (.route id liq)).2 = (routeBySent s id liq).2 := by rfl

theorem test_obs_parent (t : Truth) (q : Nat) (f : Bool) : (t.observe (.parent q f)).nOrders = t.nOrders + 1 := by simp [Truth.observe]

theorem tmp_route_out (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : (step Build.rlp s (.route id liq)).2 = (routeBySent s id liq).2 := rfl

theorem tmp_route_st (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : (step Build.rlp s (.route id liq)).1 = (routeBySent s id liq).1 := rfl

theorem sentFor_zero_of_ne (l : List Kid) (id : Nat) (h : ∀ k ∈ l, k.parent ≠ id) : sentFor l id = 0 := by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a as ih =>
    simp only [sentFor_cons]
    have ha : a.parent ≠ id := h a (by simp)
    simp [ha]
    exact ih (fun k hk => h k (by simp [hk]))

theorem inv_start : True := trivial
-- check unfold of advance for parent

theorem chk_adv_parent (st : State) (tr : Truth) (q : Nat) (f : Bool) (b : Build) :
    (advance step b ⟨st, tr⟩ (.parent q f)).1.nParents = st.nParents + 1 := by
  simp [advance, step]

theorem inv_npq_start : (start.st.nParents = start.tr.nOrders) := by rfl

    (advance step b ⟨st, tr⟩ (.parent q f)).st.nParents = st.nParents + 1 := by
  simp [advance, step]

theorem adv_parent_nord (st : State) (tr : Truth) (q : Nat) (f : Bool) (b : Build) :
    (advance step b ⟨st, tr⟩ (.parent q f)).tr.nOrders = tr.nOrders + 1 := by
  simp [advance, Truth.observe, Truth.record]

theorem inv_nc_v1 (b : Build) (evs : List Event) :
    (run step b evs).st.nChildren = (run step b evs).tr.kids.length := by
  refine run_induction step b (fun x => x.st.nChildren = x.tr.kids.length) rfl ?_ evs

import OrderRouter.Spec
import OrderRouter.Lemmas
namespace OrderRouter

/-- Regular and RLP paths: send the available liquidity capped at the shares not yet sent. -/
def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun _ s e =>
  match e with
  | .parent q f =>
    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])
  | .route id liq => routeBySent s id liq
  | .ack _ => (s, [])
  | .fill k q =>
    if k < s.nChildren then
      let c := s.children k
      let x := min q (c.qty - c.done)
      let p := s.parents c.parent
      let p' := ({ p with cum := p.cum + x } : ParentRec)
      ({ s with parents := upd s.parents c.parent p',
                children := upd s.children k { c with done := c.done + x } }, [])
    else (s, [])

theorem test_unfold (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : (step Build.rlp s (.route id liq)).2 = (routeBySent s id liq).2 := by rfl

theorem test_obs_parent (t : Truth) (q : Nat) (f : Bool) : (t.observe (.parent q f)).nOrders = t.nOrders + 1 := by simp [Truth.observe]

theorem tmp_route_out (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : (step Build.rlp s (.route id liq)).2 = (routeBySent s id liq).2 := rfl

theorem tmp_route_st (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : (step Build.rlp s (.route id liq)).1 = (routeBySent s id liq).1 := rfl

theorem sentFor_zero_of_ne (l : List Kid) (id : Nat) (h : ∀ k ∈ l, k.parent ≠ id) : sentFor l id = 0 := by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a as ih =>
    simp only [sentFor_cons]
    have ha : a.parent ≠ id := h a (by simp)
    simp [ha]
    exact ih (fun k hk => h k (by simp [hk]))

theorem inv_start : True := trivial

theorem chk_adv_parent (st : State) (tr : Truth) (q : Nat) (f : Bool) (b : Build) :
    (advance step b ⟨st, tr⟩ (.parent q f)).1.nParents = st.nParents + 1 := by

def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id

  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then

prose: **Proof plan.** For a `fill k q`, split on whether `k` is in range. By the invariant, the state's child count equals the truth's kid length, so the state and venue are in range together; in that case they describe the same child and use the same increment `min q (qty - done)`. import OrderRouter.Spec
import OrderRouter.Lemmas
namespace OrderRouter

/-- Regular and RLP paths: send the available liquidity capped at the shares not yet sent. -/
def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun _ s e =>
  match e with
  | .parent q f =>
    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])
  | .route id liq => routeBySent s id liq
  | .ack _ => (s, [])
  | .fill k q =>
    if k < s.nChildren then
      let c := s.children k
      let x := min q (c.qty - c.done)
      let p := s.parents c.parent
      let p' := ({ p with cum := p.cum + x } : ParentRec)
      ({ s with parents := upd s.parents c.parent p',
                children := upd s.children k { c with done := c.done + x } }, [])
    else (s, [])

theorem test_unfold (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : (step Build.rlp s (.route id liq)).2 = (routeBySent s id liq).2 := by rfl

import OrderRouter.Spec
import OrderRouter.Lemmas
namespace OrderRouter

/-- Regular and RLP paths: send the available liquidity capped at the shares not yet sent. -/
def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun _ s e =>
  match e with
  | .parent q f =>
    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])
  | .route id liq => routeBySent s id liq
  | .ack _ => (s, [])
  | .fill k q =>
    if k < s.nChildren then
      let c := s.children k
      let x := min q (c.qty - c.done)
      let p := s.parents c.parent
      let p' := ({ p with cum := p.cum + x } : ParentRec)
      ({ s with parents := upd s.parents c.parent p',
                children := upd s.children k { c with done := c.done + x } }, [])
    else (s, [])

theorem test_unfold (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : (step Build.rlp s (.route id liq)).2 = (routeBySent s id liq).2 := by rfl

theorem test_obs_parent (t : Truth) (q : Nat) (f : Bool) : (t.observe (.parent q f)).nOrders = t.nOrders + 1 := by simp [Truth.observe]

theorem tmp_route_out (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : (step Build.rlp s (.route id liq)).2 = (routeBySent s id liq).2 := rfl

theorem tmp_route_st (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : (step Build.rlp s (.route id liq)).1 = (routeBySent s id liq).1 := rfl

theorem sentFor_zero_of_ne (l : List Kid) (id : Nat) (h : ∀ k ∈ l, k.parent ≠ id) : sentFor l id = 0 := by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a as ih =>
    simp only [sentFor_cons]
    have ha : a.parent ≠ id := h a (by simp)
    simp [ha]
    exact ih (fun k hk => h k (by simp [hk]))

theorem inv_start : True := trivial
-- check unfold of advance for parent

theorem chk_adv_parent (st : State) (tr : Truth) (q : Nat) (f : Bool) (b : Build) :
    (advance step b ⟨st, tr⟩ (.parent q f)).1.nParents = st.nParents + 1 := by
  simp [advance, step]

theorem inv_npq_start : (start.st.nParents = start.tr.nOrders) := by rfl

theorem adv_parent_np (st : State) (tr : Truth) (q : Nat) (f : Bool) (b : Build) :
    (advance step b ⟨st, tr⟩ (.parent q f)).st.nParents = st.nParents + 1 := by
  simp [advance, step]

theorem adv_parent_nord (st : State) (tr : Truth) (q : Nat) (f : Bool) (b : Build) :
    (advance step b ⟨st, tr⟩ (.parent q f)).tr.nOrders = tr.nOrders + 1 := by
  simp [advance, Truth.observe, Truth.record]

theorem inv_nc_v1 (b : Build) (evs : List Event) :
    (run step b evs).st.nChildren = (run step b evs).tr.kids.length := by
  refine run_induction step b (fun x => x.st.nChildren = x.tr.kids.length) rfl ?_ evs
  intro x e hx
  cases e with

    have hobs_len : ((x.tr.observe (.fill k q)).record (step b x.st (.fill k q)).2).kids.length = (x.tr.observe (.fill k q)).kids.length := by

import OrderRouter.Spec
import OrderRouter.Lemmas
namespace OrderRouter

/-- Regular and RLP paths: send the available liquidity capped at the shares not yet sent. -/
def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun _ s e =>

import OrderRouter.Spec
import OrderRouter.Lemmas
namespace OrderRouter

/-- Regular and RLP paths: send the available liquidity capped at the shares not yet sent. -/
def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun _ s e =>
  match e with
  | .parent q f =>
    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])
  | .route id liq => routeBySent s id liq
  | .ack _ => (s, [])
  | .fill k q =>
    if k < s.nChildren then
      let c := s.children k
      let x := min q (c.qty - c.done)
      let p := s.parents c.parent
      let p' := ({ p with cum := p.cum + x } : ParentRec)
      ({ s with parents := upd s.parents c.parent p',
                children := upd s.children k { c with done := c.done + x } }, [])
    else (s, [])

theorem test_unfold (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : (step Build.rlp s (.route id liq)).2 = (routeBySent s id liq).2 := by rfl

import OrderRouter.Spec
import OrderRouter.Lemmas
namespace OrderRouter

/-- Regular and RLP paths: send the available liquidity capped at the shares not yet sent. -/
def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun _ s e =>
  match e with
  | .parent q f =>
    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])
  | .route id liq => routeBySent s id liq
  | .ack _ => (s, [])
  | .fill k q =>
    if k < s.nChildren then
      let c := s.children k
      let x := min q (c.qty - c.done)
      let p := s.parents c.parent
      let p' := ({ p with cum := p.cum + x } : ParentRec)
      ({ s with parents := upd s.parents c.parent p',
                children := upd s.children k { c with done := c.done + x } }, [])
    else (s, [])

def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun _ s e =>
  match e with
  | .parent q f =>
    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])
  | .route id liq => routeBySent s id liq
  | .ack _ => (s, [])
  | .fill k q =>
    if k < s.nChildren then
      let c := s.children k
      let x := min q (c.qty - c.done)
      let p := s.parents c.parent
      let p' := ({ p with cum := p.cum + x } : ParentRec)
      ({ s with parents := upd s.parents c.parent p',

    else (s, [])

/-!
# Child-order router specification (protected)

A model of an automated order router of the kind described in the SEC order against Knight
Capital Americas LLC (Release No. 34-70694, October 16, 2013), reconstructed from the SEC
findings. Knight's code is not public; nothing here is Knight's code.

The router receives parent orders and, as liquidity becomes available, sends child orders
to trading venues for execution (paragraph 12 of the order). Each parent order carries a
flag; in the order, the flag that formerly activated "Power Peg" was repurposed for the
Retail Liquidity Program (paragraph 13). Each server runs one code version, and on
August 1, 2012 one of the eight servers still had the Power Peg code (paragraphs 15 and 16).

Every requirement is a predicate over an implementation `step : Impl` and quantifies over
every code version, every flag value, every parent order and every sequence of events
(new parent orders, routing opportunities, acknowledgements and execution reports,
including reports for unknown child orders and reports larger than the order). The
locked challenge (`OrderRouter/Challenge.lean`) applies each one to the definition hole
`OrderRouter.step`.

The quantities the requirements talk about (shares ordered, shares sent in child orders,
shares executed) are computed by this file from the event sequence and the child orders the
router emitted, never from the router's own state, so a router cannot satisfy them by
under-reporting.
-/

namespace OrderRouter

/-- The code version a server runs. `rlp` is the new code; `legacy` is a server to which the
new code was not copied, where the Power Peg code is still present and callable. -/
inductive Build where
  | rlp
  | legacy
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- A child order as sent to a venue: the parent order it represents and its share
quantity. Child orders are numbered 0, 1, 2, ... in the order they are sent. -/
structure Child where
  parent : Nat
  qty    : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Inputs to the router. Parent orders are numbered 0, 1, 2, ... in arrival order.
`route id liq` is a routing opportunity for parent `id`: venues show `liq` shares
available. `ack k` acknowledges child order `k`. `fill k q` is an execution report:
`q` shares of child order `k` were executed. -/
inductive Event where
  | parent (qty : Nat) (flag : Bool)
  | route (id : Nat) (liq : Nat)
  | ack (child : Nat)
  | fill (child : Nat) (q : Nat)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Function update. -/
def upd {α : Type} (f : Nat → α) (k : Nat) (v : α) : Nat → α :=
  fun j => if j = k then v else f j

/-! ## Router state (the implementation reads and writes it) -/

/-- The router's record of a parent order: its quantity and flag, the shares it has sent in
child orders, and its cumulative executed quantity (the "cumulative quantity function" of
paragraph 14 of the order). -/
structure ParentRec where
  qty  : Nat
  flag : Bool
  sent : Nat
  cum  : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- The router's record of a child order: its parent, quantity and executed shares. -/
structure ChildRec where
  parent : Nat
  qty    : Nat
  done   : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Router state: parent records `0` to `nParents - 1` and child records `0` to
`nChildren - 1`. -/
structure State where
  nParents  : Nat
  parents   : Nat → ParentRec
  nChildren : Nat
  children  : Nat → ChildRec

/-- The router's state before any event. -/
def init : State :=
  { nParents := 0, parents := fun _ => ⟨0, false, 0, 0⟩,
    nChildren := 0, children := fun _ => ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ }

/-- A router: given the server's code version, its state and an event, the next state and
the child orders it sends in response. -/
abbrev Impl := Build → State → Event → State × List Child

/-! ## What actually happened (computed by this file, not by the router) -/

/-- A child order with the number of its shares executed at the venue. -/
structure Kid where
  parent : Nat
  qty    : Nat
  done   : Nat

import OrderRouter.Spec
import OrderRouter.Lemmas
namespace OrderRouter

/-- Regular and RLP paths: send the available liquidity capped at the shares not yet sent. -/
def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun _ s e =>
  match e with
  | .parent q f =>
    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])
  | .route id liq => routeBySent s id liq
  | .ack _ => (s, [])
  | .fill k q =>
    if k < s.nChildren then
      let c := s.children k
      let x := min q (c.qty - c.done)
      let p := s.parents c.parent
      let p' := ({ p with cum := p.cum + x } : ParentRec)
      ({ s with parents := upd s.parents c.parent p',
                children := upd s.children k { c with done := c.done + x } }, [])
    else (s, [])

theorem test_unfold (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : (step Build.rlp s (.route id liq)).2 = (routeBySent s id liq).2 := by rfl

theorem test_obs_parent (t : Truth) (q : Nat) (f : Bool) : (t.observe (.parent q f)).nOrders = t.nOrders + 1 := by simp [Truth.observe]

theorem tmp_route_out (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : (step Build.rlp s (.route id liq)).2 = (routeBySent s id liq).2 := rfl

theorem tmp_route_st (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : (step Build.rlp s (.route id liq)).1 = (routeBySent s id liq).1 := rfl

theorem sentFor_zero_of_ne (l : List Kid) (id : Nat) (h : ∀ k ∈ l, k.parent ≠ id) : sentFor l id = 0 := by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a as ih =>
    simp only [sentFor_cons]
    have ha : a.parent ≠ id := h a (by simp)
    simp [ha]
    exact ih (fun k hk => h k (by simp [hk]))

theorem inv_start : True := trivial
-- check unfold of advance for parent

theorem chk_adv_parent (st : State) (tr : Truth) (q : Nat) (f : Bool) (b : Build) :
    (advance step b ⟨st, tr⟩ (.parent q f)).1.nParents = st.nParents + 1 := by
  simp [advance, step]

theorem inv_npq_start : (start.st.nParents = start.tr.nOrders) := by rfl

theorem adv_parent_np (st : State) (tr : Truth) (q : Nat) (f : Bool) (b : Build) :
    (advance step b ⟨st, tr⟩ (.parent q f)).st.nParents = st.nParents + 1 := by
  simp [advance, step]

theorem adv_parent_nord (st : State) (tr : Truth) (q : Nat) (f : Bool) (b : Build) :
    (advance step b ⟨st, tr⟩ (.parent q f)).tr.nOrders = tr.nOrders + 1 := by
  simp [advance, Truth.observe, Truth.record]

theorem inv_nc_v1 (b : Build) (evs : List Event) :
    (run step b evs).st.nChildren = (run step b evs).tr.kids.length := by
  refine run_induction step b (fun x => x.st.nChildren = x.tr.kids.length) rfl ?_ evs
  intro x e hx
  cases e with
  | parent q f =>
    show ((advance step b x (.parent q f)).st.nChildren = (advance step b x (.parent q f)).tr.kids.length)
    simp [advance, step, Truth.observe, Truth.record, hx]
  | route id liq =>
    show ((advance step b x (.route id liq)).st.nChildren = (advance step b x (.route id liq)).tr.kids.length)
    simp only [advance]
    have hrec : ∀ (t : Truth) (out : List Child), (t.record out).kids.length = t.kids.length + out.length := by
      intro t out; simp [Truth.record]

    show ((advance step b x (.ack k)).st.nChildren = (advance step b x (.ack k)).tr.kids.length)
    simp [advance, step, Truth.observe, Truth.record, hx]
  | fill k q =>
    show ((advance step b x (.fill k q)).st.nChildren = (advance step b x (.fill k q)).tr.kids.length)

    have hobs_len : ((x.tr.observe (.fill k q)).record (step b x.st (.fill k q)).2).kids.length = (x.tr.observe (.fill k q)).kids.length := by

import OrderRouter.Spec
import OrderRouter.Lemmas
namespace OrderRouter

/-- Regular and RLP paths: send the available liquidity capped at the shares not yet sent. -/
def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun _ s e =>
  match e with
  | .parent q f =>
    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])
  | .route id liq => routeBySent s id liq
  | .ack _ => (s, [])
  | .fill k q =>
    if k < s.nChildren then
      let c := s.children k
      let x := min q (c.qty - c.done)
      let p := s.parents c.parent
      let p' := ({ p with cum := p.cum + x } : ParentRec)
      ({ s with parents := upd s.parents c.parent p',
                children := upd s.children k { c with done := c.done + x } }, [])
    else (s, [])

theorem test_unfold (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : (step Build.rlp s (.route id liq)).2 = (routeBySent s id liq).2 := by rfl

theorem test_obs_parent (t : Truth) (q : Nat) (f : Bool) : (t.observe (.parent q f)).nOrders = t.nOrders + 1 := by simp [Truth.observe]

theorem tmp_route_out (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : (step Build.rlp s (.route id liq)).2 = (routeBySent s id liq).2 := rfl

theorem tmp_route_st (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : (step Build.rlp s (.route id liq)).1 = (routeBySent s id liq).1 := rfl

theorem sentFor_zero_of_ne (l : List Kid) (id : Nat) (h : ∀ k ∈ l, k.parent ≠ id) : sentFor l id = 0 := by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a as ih =>
    simp only [sentFor_cons]
    have ha : a.parent ≠ id := h a (by simp)
    simp [ha]
    exact ih (fun k hk => h k (by simp [hk]))

theorem inv_start : True := trivial
-- check unfold of advance for parent

theorem chk_adv_parent (st : State) (tr : Truth) (q : Nat) (f : Bool) (b : Build) :
    (advance step b ⟨st, tr⟩ (.parent q f)).1.nParents = st.nParents + 1 := by

    (advance step b ⟨st, tr⟩ (.parent q f)).st.nParents = st.nParents + 1 := by
  simp [advance, step]

theorem adv_parent_nord (st : State) (tr : Truth) (q : Nat) (f : Bool) (b : Build) :
    (advance step b ⟨st, tr⟩ (.parent q f)).tr.nOrders = tr.nOrders + 1 := by
  simp [advance, Truth.observe, Truth.record]

theorem inv_nc_v1 (b : Build) (evs : List Event) :
    (run step b evs).st.nChildren = (run step b evs).tr.kids.length := by
  refine run_induction step b (fun x => x.st.nChildren = x.tr.kids.length) rfl ?_ evs
  intro x e hx
  cases e with
  | parent q f =>
    show ((advance step b x (.parent q f)).st.nChildren = (advance step b x (.parent q f)).tr.kids.length)

  | route id liq =>

    simp only [advance]

    simp [advance, step, Truth.observe, Truth.record, hx]

  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun _ s e =>
  match e with
  | .parent q f =>
    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])
  | .route id liq => routeBySent s id liq
  | .ack _ => (s, [])
  | .fill k q =>
    if k < s.nChildren then
      let c := s.children k
      let x := min q (c.qty - c.done)
      let p := s.parents c.parent
      let p' := ({ p with cum := p.cum + x } : ParentRec)
      ({ s with parents := upd s.parents c.parent p',
                children := upd s.children k { c with done := c.done + x } }, [])
    else (s, [])

import OrderRouter.Spec
import OrderRouter.Lemmas
namespace OrderRouter

/-- Regular and RLP paths: send the available liquidity capped at the shares not yet sent. -/
def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun _ s e =>
  match e with
  | .parent q f =>
    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])
  | .route id liq => routeBySent s id liq
  | .ack _ => (s, [])
  | .fill k q =>
    if k < s.nChildren then
      let c := s.children k
      let x := min q (c.qty - c.done)
      let p := s.parents c.parent
      let p' := ({ p with cum := p.cum + x } : ParentRec)
      ({ s with parents := upd s.parents c.parent p',
                children := upd s.children k { c with done := c.done + x } }, [])
    else (s, [])
